properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Largely vacant site to the western edge of the village that is part occupied by domestic garages with the remainder vacant hardstanding. Potentially this land could provide opportunity for a small-scale development, appropriate to the rural environment. Application for construction of 4 dwellings now permitted (17/02172/FUL). Now classified as a small site in the SHLAA.
